name: Ryuugasaki Ayako
source:
New homeroom teacher. She is 167cm tall.

She is smart, but weak and a pushover. She's a capable teacher but messes up frequently.

She mistook the nudist camp for a nature camp.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/SYG/index.html]official site[/url]]
